functions.description: tint model texture palette by color
functions.notes: Size and shape are correct (0x390, same instructions); only register assignment differs (80 bytes). Target keeps color in r4, red r5, green r6, blue sl, output r7, index sb, state/texture r8; mine gets state r4, color r8, index r7, red fp, output sl. Tried: output=NULL placement, decl order permutations, int vs ushort types, block-scope vs function-scope offset/length/source, object/texture decl hoisting, colorsweep --apply (no change). Block-scope offset/length gives target-like per-mode regs but shifts color to r7. Logic: GetField9e mode 0 = add rgb with clamp 31, mode 1 = fill with color, mode 2 = scale by color/31.0f; staged to texture palette VRAM (VRAMSubregion 0); buffer from AllocateAligned4(data_02114e20), freed with TailForward02012da4 after Unlock. Sibling func_0203db44 has the mode 0 loop. Runner k lacked exec bit; invoked as 'bash k'.
